Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in while turning left in Houston, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state where you were driving and what you were doing just before the collision.
A: I was driving my sedan through an intersection with a green light. I was turning left onto the cross street, and I was
going slowly because I had to yield to oncoming traffic.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle befroe impact?
A: Not at first. I saw it when it was already close, maybe a second or two before we collided. It came from the
opposite directoin and crossed into my path.
Q: How fast do you estimate the other vehicle was traveling?
A: It was faster than I expected. I'd guess it was well above the posted limit, but I can't say for certain.
Q: Where did the impact occur on your vehicle?
A: On the driver's side, toward the front wheel. My airbag did not deploy, but I was thrown against the seatbelt and felt
a sharp pain in my lower back right away.
Q: Have you sought medical attnetion since the collision?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They said I had a back strain and gave me muscle
relaxers and told me to rest and follow up with my own doctor.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?
A: Yes, I still have stiffness and some pain when I bend or sit for a long time. I've been taking it easy at work and I'm
doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
